course_name_original: STRUMENTI E METODI PER LA CARATTERIZZAZIONE DI MATERIALI METALLICI T (95245)
course_name_en: TOOLS AND METHODS FOR THE CHARACTERIZATION OF METALLIC MATERIALS T (95245)
prerequisites: Basics of Science of Metals and Metallurgy skills

learning_outcomes.text: At the end of the course, the student gains knowledge about the characterization techniques for metallic materials in order to assess if their characteristics (mechanical, chemical, physical and microstructural) match with the requirements reported in the design.
Define proper technical specifications concerning the metallic materials used for the production of mechanical components.
Correlate material properties - processing and microstructure.
Identify the reason for malfunctioning related to material features.

syllabus_topics: Optical (OM), Scanning Electron (SEM) and Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM): basic operating principles.
Quantitative metallography of metal alloys by means of image analyses software.
Chemical analyses (EDS, GD-OES), X-ray diffraction analyses (XRD) and thermal analyses (DSC/DTA/TGA): basic operating principles and data analysis.
Elements of common non destructive testing used in industrial field for the detection of defects in metallic components (ultrasonic testing, penetrant liquids, industrial computed tomography).
Fracture surface analysis and failure analysis
Fracture surface analysis by means of stereo, multifocus and scanning electron microscopes.
teaching_methods: Classroom exercises using PCs, free programs, and material provided by the teacher

assessment_methods.method: Oral examination focused on case studies and practical exercises

assessment_rules: The final examination consists of an oral examination focused on the case studies and practical exercises carried out during the course. The aim is to assess the achievement of the learning outcomes.
